assembly.name: Front brake corner (left)
assembly.description: Golf R Mk7 front brake: 340 × 30 mm ventilated disc with a single-piston floating (sliding) aluminium caliper, painted blue with the R script, on a cast carrier. Torque values are from the project dossier; OEM part numbers are not yet verified and are logged in docs/UNVERIFIED.md.

parts.name: Brake disc, front (340 × 30 mm ventilated)
parts.description: Ventilated front disc, 340 mm diameter × 30 mm thick (dossier §6). Hat section bolts to the hub flange; friction ring is internally vented. Grey cast iron is typical for this application but the material is not stated in the dossier, so it is left unverified.

parts.name: Brake caliper housing, front (single-piston floating)
parts.description: Single-piston floating (sliding) caliper in aluminium, painted blue with the R script (dossier §6). Slides on guide pins in the carrier; one piston on the inboard side clamps both pads against the disc.

parts.name: Caliper carrier, front
parts.description: Carrier (bracket) bolted rigidly to the wheel bearing housing; the caliper slides on guide pins seated in the carrier and the pads locate in its machined abutments. Material not stated in the dossier.

parts.name: Brake pad, front outer
parts.description: Outboard pad: steel backing plate with bonded friction material, locating in the carrier abutments. (Note from dossier §6: it is the REAR pads that are R-specific and not interchangeable with the GTI Performance Pack.)

parts.name: Brake pad, front inner
parts.description: Inboard pad, acted on directly by the caliper piston. Steel backing plate with bonded friction material. Front-left pad position typically carries the wear sensor on VW models (sensor not modelled yet).

parts.name: Caliper guide bolts (caliper to carrier), M8 ×2
parts.description: Guide (slide) pin bolts securing the floating caliper to the carrier. Torque from dossier §2 table: caliper-to-carrier 35 Nm.

parts.name: Carrier bolts (carrier to bearing housing), M12 ×2
parts.description: Bolts fixing the caliper carrier to the wheel bearing housing. Torque from dossier §2 table: front caliper(-carrier)-to-bearing-housing 200 Nm. Replace-after-use status not stated in the dossier.
